gen-gf-revalia-gf-changa: Changa stands tall, its lowercase built with the heft of cast-iron capitals. Revalia sprawls above it, loose-limbed and showy, its g hanging open at the bottom, so the sans below feels like solid ground.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-epunda-sans: Expressive Revalia strolls along with widely spaced letters and an open-bottomed g, while Epunda Sans keeps oversized counters full of daylight. Revalia does its best work on a word or two.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-fragment-mono: Fragment Mono lines its letters up like nails on a ruler, while Revalia sprawls above with a loose, showy stride. Over pages, the monospace text settles into a flat, steady gray hum.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-geom: Approachable Geom carries a lofty lowercase band, while Revalia up top swaggers with an open-curved g and wide-set letters. Page after page, the text in Geom reads lofty, friendly and unhurried.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-inder: A lowercase g with its lower curve left open gives Revalia a loose, showy stride across wide-set letters. Inder does the quieter job, keeping lowercase and capitals close in height so text stays tidy and clean.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-jaldi: Jaldi looks brushed on, its letters barely separated and its c gaping wide at any size. Jaldi lifts its lowercase well above the usual, a sturdy sans-serif partner for Revalia's loose display letters.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Revalia swaggers across the line with wide-set letters and a g whose lower curve stays open. Kdam Thmor Pro then fills the lines with bowls, giving long text a contemporary, full-bodied texture.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-magra: Magra reads big-bodied in every lowercase word, which gives Revalia's loose, open-bottomed display letters something sturdy to lean on. Shrink Revalia down small and its showy swagger fades fast.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-matemasie: A lowercase g with its lower curve left open marks Revalia out, along with a relaxed stride across wide-set letters. And if Revalia shrinks, Matemasie, with its broad gaps and clean build, would simply outshout it.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-mitr: Revalia's open-bottomed g gives it a loose, showy stride, while Mitr keeps very little gap between lowercase and capital height. Paragraphs in Mitr feel dense yet approachable, with a contemporary look.
